From Tokens to Features: Architecting Cost Attribution for AI-Assisted Engineering

WHEN: Thursday, October 29, 2026 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM EDT

AI coding tools are widely deployed, but teams often lack the telemetry to measure impact on speed, quality, and cost. This session explores connecting LLM usage and spend to developer sessions, commits, PRs, tickets, and delivered features.
